name: Eric Adams
role: Mayor of New York City (2022-2025); Brooklyn borough president (2014-2021); New York state senator (2006-2013); NYPD captain
summary: Moderate Democrat and former police captain who campaigned and governed on public safety, rejecting 'defund the police' while backing police reform, gun-law changes and more technology in policing. He is pro-union, supports abortion and LGBTQ protections, favors housing construction and business incentives, and in office opposed raising taxes on high earners. He mixes openly religious language with a stated commitment that government and religion stay out of each other.
